title: Benchmark arm (daedalus.bench-arm/1)
description: One arm file under bench/arms/. Stays inside the validator subset of .claude/scripts/validate-profile.py. bench/run.py validate also checks that every real arm shares the same model, effort, permission, auto-approver, instruction and base CLI arguments (AC-10).

driver.description: claude: steps call the Claude Code CLI (a model, so money); fake: bench/lib/fake_agent.py, no model.

model.description: Model id, or the shared placeholder $BENCH_MODEL resolved from --model or the environment.

effort.description: Effort level, or the shared placeholder $BENCH_EFFORT.

permission.description: Permission mode passed to the CLI. Broad modes are allowed only because the container is the boundary.

auto_approver.description: How AskUserQuestion is answered: always the first option, identically for every arm. Each call counts as a human intervention.

instruction.description: The non-interactive instruction appended to every prompt (§3.8).

max_turns.description: Per-step --max-turns cap, passed through the {max_turns} argv token. Shared by every real arm (validate checks it); the value is a placeholder until the pilot sizes it. --max-budget-usd is a client-side estimate that can overshoot, so a claude arm must pass both.

glob.description: With from=file: workspace glob of the file holding the findings JSON (a findings.json block inside Markdown is accepted).

review_patch.description: How review tasks present the defect patch: uncommitted (default, §3.8) or committed on a neutral feature/<name> review branch with origin/<branch> at the base (what a merge-base..HEAD reviewer such as argus --local sees).

resume_hint.description: Text a recovery task's resume steps can insert with {resume_hint}. Tokens: {ticket_path}, {slug}, {branch}.

exclude_from_scoring.description: Globs of the arm's own artifacts (plans, reviews, findings), excluded from unnecessary-change scoring.

pause_s.description: Seconds the fake agent waits between its tool_use event and the edit (recovery tests).

action.description: build_plugins: export the hub at `ref` (git archive) into a temporary folder outside <arm_dir>, run its scripts/build-plugin.sh there, copy only plugins/<name> to <arm_dir>/plugins/<name>, and write <arm_dir>/BUILD.json. Nothing else reaches <arm_dir>, which every step mounts at /arm.

prompt_template.description: Tokens: {ticket_path} (the run's copy of the ticket file: the ticket is delivered as data, never inline; {ticket} is rejected here), {instruction}, {slug} (the task's neutral plan slug), {branch}, {resume_hint}. There is no {task_id}: nothing an agent sees names the task. Other braces stay literal.

fresh_process.description: true: a new process (the /clear equivalent); false: continue the previous session with cli.continue_args.

kinds.description: Task kinds this step runs for (default: all).

argv.description: Command template. Tokens: {prompt}, {model}, {effort}, {permission}, {step_budget_usd}, {max_turns}, {settings}, {arm_dir}, {tools_dir}, {home}. A claude arm must pass --max-turns {max_turns}.

verify_in_t0.description: Flags not yet confirmed on the pinned CLI (P0b T0). A live run refuses to start while this is non-empty unless --t0-verified is passed.
